summary: Community Health Systems (CYH) filed an 8-K reporting early tender results of its cash tender offer for up to $600M aggregate purchase price of its 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 and 10.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2032. As of early tender date, 94.05% of 2031 notes ($994.8M principal) and 46.18% of 2032 notes ($822.0M principal) were tendered, with proration applied to 2031 notes. The Issuer is CHS/Community Health Systems Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary. No board recommendation or advisor named. The offer is a debt management liability reduction, not equity. Watch for final acceptance and settlement; risk-arb angle limited as this is a bond tender, not equity.
